checks.name: U1 legal: end-point floor exact, no passing through, overlaps only shrink, zero distance / zero length safe, chords round a body within TOL
U2 resolve fuzz: every accepted move finite, never closer than the floor, never through a body, never further than claimed, free = the claim, a separated pair stays separated, peers untouched
U3 no creep: 100 000 claims of 0.01 px and 2 000 zig-zag 1 px claims straight at a body from contact end no closer than D
U4 sweepPath: every leg up to the accepted point legal from its own start, never closer than the floor, a fully legal route accepted to its end
U5 freeSpot: deterministic, clear, >= D + 8 from every peer; with every candidate taken, the target itself (crowded)
B the peer sweep costs <= 5 us per packet with seven peers at p99, in every regime (far, into one, a crowd of seven, the slide refused and the bisection)
